title: Academic Tarot Cards box
author: Marcel Padilla

capture.surface: irregular dotted mat (texture for COLMAP feature matching)

pipeline.training: Brush (built from main), 30000 iters, 500k splat cap, 647 s

steps: cropped from the 500k full scene to the object alone
trimmed 101 stretched floater splats (max splat scale 0.61 -> 0.32)

caveats: Colors are NOT colorimetrically faithful to the physical object: the lineage includes a manual recolor step that altered RGBA only. Geometry is unaltered.
Spherical harmonics were dropped (SH degree 0), so there is no view-dependent shading.
Scale is the COLMAP reconstruction scale and is not metric.
The source video and the trained 500k .ply were deleted, so this file cannot be regenerated.
